mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% for three consecutive months signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate deteriorating housing sector health, which contracts consumer demand and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: In more than 30% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both decline for 2 consecutive months, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: During high labor slack regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals worsening employment conditions that reduce consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 35% of instances where UNRATE>6.0% and PAYEMS declines for 1 month, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains above 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in 50% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer spending (RSAFS) falls below its 6-month moving average by more than 1.5%, it signals weakening retail demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS falls below 6-month moving average by more than 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary easing to combat inflation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 30% of instances where CPIAUCSL>3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS declines for 1 month, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% for 3 consecutive months.
